articleTitle: Siamese Network-based Open Set Identification of Communications Emitters with Comprehensive Features
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Radio frequency (RF) fingerprint-based identification schemes is of great significance in the domain of wireless devices, and we use them to complete device identification and authentication tasks. They extract the features caused by the inherent hardware circuits, which are very hard to forge. Recently, a large number of RF fingerprint identification methods based on deep learning have emerged. However, they make the close world assumption that the communications emitters appeared in the test data must have appeared in training. This assumption does not hold in open world classification. In this paper, we propose an open set identification method based on Siamese Network, dealing with the open set identification of communications emitters. Our method can extract more comprehensive signals features and has a better open set recognition effect. In addition, our method is more robust. In the case of increasing openness, it can still ensure sufficient discrimination between close set and open set classes.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOv5 for Remote Sensing Rotating Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Remote sensing image object detection is a challenging task owing to high resolution, dense distribution of small objects, and rotating objects at any angle. In this study, aiming to improve the performance of remote sensing image object detection, we propose a lightweight remote sensing rotating object detection model based on YOLOv5. To solve the problem of detecting rotating objects at any angle, we transform the angle regression problem into a classification problem, making the model predict one more angle information, which is used to rotate the horizontal bounding box to enclose the rotating objects at any angle. Aiming at the dense distribution of small objects in remote sensing images, we improve the detection layer structure of the model and add a object detection scale to pay more attention to small objects. Moreover, we also replace the BottleneckCSP module in the YOLOv5 Backbone network with the GhostBottleneck module to reduce the amount of model parameters and lighten the model. We conducted experiments on the public dataset DOTA. Experimental results show that our proposed model has achieved good detection results and the model size is only 13.4M, which can be effectively used for remote sensing object detection and can be easily deployed to the corresponding platform.

articleTitle: Radio Environment Map Construction with Gaussian Process and Kernel Transformation
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Crowd-sourced spectrum sensing has gained tremendous attention in recent years. Spatial spectrum inference (SSI), based on sensor data, can be implemented into radio environment map (REM) construction. To our best knowledge, no prior work has analyzed the environmental heterogeneity on SSI and REM construction, which is the natural character of radio propagation. In this paper, we innovatively propose a transformed kernel learning (TKL) method based on the Gaussian process (GP) for SSI by considering the environmental heterogeneity. The experimental results show a considerable improvement in root mean square error and continuous rank probability score compared to existing state-of-art SSI methods.

articleTitle: Face recognition algorithm based on open CV
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology and the continuous improvement of people's security awareness, people pay more and more attention to the research of face recognition. Open CV is an open source cross platform computer vision library, which realizes many common algorithms in image processing and computer vision. QT is a cross platform C++ GUI application development framework, which can be used to develop both GUI and non GUI programs. This paper first introduces the face recognition method. The process of face recognition includes three parts: face detection, face representation and face recognition. Secondly, the face recognition algorithm is studied, and PCA algorithm is used for face recognition. Then we use Visual Studio 2013 to build a face recognition system based on open CV, design the user interface with QT, and realize the face model detection and recognition training: open the image, carry out face detection and location, face feature annotation, and then open the second photo for recognition. At the same time, each module and the whole process of the system are tested, the test results are good, and a complete face detection and recognition system based on open CV is realized.

articleTitle: Satellite communication anti-jamming based on artificial bee colony blind source separation
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Satellite communication anti-jamming methods at present are mostly based on spread spectrum and filtering technology. There is defects for these methods on the performance of spectrum efficiency and anti-jamming. In this paper, we investigated the separation of communication signal and jamming signal to obtain communication anti-jamming. In the proposed method, only the independency characteristic between the communication signal and the jamming signal is used. The separation problem is essentially a multi-parameter joint optimization problem, and there is no analytical solution. This paper uses an artificial bee colony optimization algorithm to solve the blind separation problem and obtains a sub-optimal solution.

articleTitle: Research on Color Feature Extraction Method of Digital Camouflage Based on Visual Perception
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Color is one of its major features of image recognition, also a key factor in affecting camouflage effect. At present, the methods of color feature extraction used take no account of human visual perception, which may result in inaccurate color feature extraction and lead to bad effect of the digital camouflage in the practical application. In this paper, a new method of color feature extraction of digital camouflage based on color histograms combined with human visual perception is proposed. By introducing visual attention function into the traditional color histogram, several dominant colors are obtained as the color features of digital camouflage. The experiment results shows that the color features extracted by our method are more closed to the background images, in order to reduce the detection probability of target.

articleTitle: A Spaceborne Multi-channel SAR Imaging Algorithm for Moving Targets
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Spaceborne multi-channel SAR is an effective means to achieve high-resolution and wide-swath imaging. Due to the signal undersampling, the unambiguous spectrum reconstruction should be conducted firstly. However, the channel imbalance will cause the failure of reconstruction. For moving targets, the motion will result in inter-channel phase error. Different motion speeds correspond to different phase errors, and hence the existing methods which estimate a uniform phase error fail to estimate the phase errors of each target. To solve the problem, the paper analyses the phase error caused by target motion and proposes a multi-channel SAR imaging algorithm for moving targets. By estimate the phase errors of moving targets separately, the phase errors can be compensated accurately. After compensating the inter-channel phase errors, the accurate imaging can be conducted to obtain a well-focusing SAR image without azimuth ambiguity. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by a computer simulation.

articleTitle: Wind Speed Prediction based on Long Short-Term Memory network and Policy Suggestions for Wind Power Industry Development
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: As a new energy source, the use of wind power is conducive to the protection of global resources and the environment, thus it plays an increasingly important role in alleviating the energy crisis. Due to the fluctuation and strong randomness of wind speed, wind power generation is difficult to integrate into the grid. To overcome these challenges and further enhance wind speed forecasting performance and stability, a forecasting method is developed based on long short-term memory network. To verify the properties of this deep learning algorithm, the 15-min wind speed data of four wind farms in Inner Mongolia of China are analyzed. The results of root mean square error, mean absolute error and mean absolute percentage error show that this new algorithm is superior to the autoregressive integrated moving average model in prediction accuracy and stability. Among them, compared with the ARIMA model, the root mean square error of the new model for Datasets 1-4 decreased by 60.40%, 52.19%, 75.12% and 85.64%, respectively. Thus, deep learning algorithm based on long short-term memory network is extremely useful for enhancing prediction precision, and is a reasonable and valid tool for intelligent grid programming. It also provides strong technical support for the formulation of wind power industry policies. In the future, we should improve the legal regulatory system and diversified financial tools, as well as strengthening scientific research incentive mechanisms to promote the development of the wind power industry.

articleTitle: Fast Thermal Infrared Image Ground Object Detection Method based on Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Nowadays, there is an increasing demand for wild searching and nature reserve monitoring in nighttime environment. Combined with the advantages of thermal infrared (TIR) imaging technology and the flexibility of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), the UAV thermal infrared remote sensing can provide sufficient image data as the information source of decision-making and judgment for multi scene object detection task at night. In order to process these image data quickly and accurately, and to realize the purpose of ground object detection, this paper investigates a fast thermal infrared image ground object detection method based on deep learning algorithm. The proposed method achieves good accuracy and speed performance on the dataset, which shows 64.35% mAP with 41.83 FPS. This method is superior to the other general detection algorithms in detection accuracy and detection speed.

articleTitle: Recognition of Unsegmented and Challenging License Plate Based on Multi-scale Information Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: To automatically recognize blurred license plate images produced in extreme weather conditions, a new recognition network structure based on the indivisible highway challenging license plate was proposed. The network structure consists of feature extraction network and recognition framework. Experimental research was carried out with the Southeast University Blurred Chinese License Plate Dataset (SBCLPD). And the results showed that the Inception V3 features combined with CNN recognition framework offered better performance than other five counterparts, which achieved over 89.62% accuracy in comparative experiments.

articleTitle: Quality evaluation of infrared live detection for transformation equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Infrared detection is a common live detection way to check the equipment condition. The detection quality directly affects the evaluation and diagnosis of equipment condition. In this paper, we propose a quality evaluation method to find whether the infrared detection meet the demands for live detection requirements. The cosine and feature similarity are adopted to find similarity of infrared images at different measure points. Then, equipment saliency in the image and environment situation are considered. Finally, a decision tree are used to find the classification rule of decide the detection quality level. Experiments demonstrate the practicability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on the recognition and location method of stacked bagged agricultural materials based on monocular vision
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a monocular vision based recognition and location method to solve the problom of recognition and location of stacked bagged agricultural materials in the train, including image recognition algorithm based on watershed transformation and target location algorithm based on image moments. In addition, the proposed algorithms are validated by carrying out experiments on the machine vision test platform for 25kg flour bags. The experimental results showed that the image recognition algorithm based on watershed transform is good. The target location algorithm based on image moments can effectively control the camera to move to the desired position.

articleTitle: In-situ monitoring of selective laser melting based on heterogeneous integration of acoustic signals and images
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Monitoring during the selective laser melting (SLM) process is the only way to achieve 100% Non Destructive Testing (NDT) for parts produced. This work provided a heterogeneous integration monitoring with acoustic signals and images. Acoustic signal features and image features could indicate different states of the melting and then their signal features were extracted by deep belief networks (DBN) and convolutional neural networks (CNN) respectively. Heterogeneous features were used to recognize the sates of the melting by Support vector machines (SVM) method.Classifications were carried out with acoustic signal and image features respectively for comparisons. The optimal classification rate came from fused features from acoustic signals and images. The results indicated that the fused features improved the defect diagnosis capabilities for the SLM process. It is effective and promising by recognizing heterogeneous integrated signals for the in-situ monitoring of the SLM process.

articleTitle: Labeling of Radio Signal by Jointly Using Feature Engineering and Unsupervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: For the purpose of radio transmitter identification with deep learning under non-cooperative conditions, this paper proposes a radio frequency(RF) signal sample labeling method based on unsupervised learning and radio frequency fingerprints. Firstly, extracted the carrier component fingerprint information of the radio signal to form a characteristic vector of representative individual information. Then utilized an unsupervised learning method which is improved by canopy algorithm to realize sample labeling of individual transmitter. The experimental process is based on the ACARS signal, used six types of ACARS signals with different IDs to verify the performance of the method. The results revealed that the accuracy of the method for the overall identification and labeling of radio frequency signals was over 96%.

articleTitle: Performance of Hybrid Satellite-Terrestrial Relay Systems Using Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: The performance of a hybrid satellite-terrestrial relay system using non-orthogonal multiple access (HSTRS-NOMA) is studied in this paper. In the satellite communication scenario considered in this paper, a satellite transmits signals to a terrestrial user under the help of a terrestrial decode-and-forward relay. We derive the achievable average rate and the outage probability of the system under independent Shadowed-Rician satellite channels and Nakagami fading terrestrial channels. Furthermore, the asymptotic outage probability of the system in the case of high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is proposed. Finally, we present the simulation results to verify the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Similarity measurement of underwater complex model simulation and acoustic image test
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Target echo is the information source of active sonar, and the feature information of target echo highlight has important reference value for the detection and identification of active sonar system. According to the continuous acquisition of echo highlight at different azimuth angles, a bright spot sound image is formed in order to intuitively and effectively show the change rule of the target echo bright spot characteristics. In this paper, the target echo highlight-angle sound image simulation adopts the 1:20 scale Benchmark model, and use the image comparison method to compare the simulation results with the measured data. By comparing the results, it can be seen that under different signals and split angles, the two have a higher degree of similarity. And it is verified that the image contrast method in the research field of bright spot feature is effective.

articleTitle: Kidney Region of Interest Extraction Based on Iterative Convolution Threshold Method
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: The kidney is one of the essential organs in the human body, and the premise of evaluating kidney function is to obtain kidney segmentation accurately. Some kidney segmentation methods have achieved high segmentation accuracy in the past, but the segmentation rate has also decreased with accuracy. In this paper, based on the renal time-activity curve, an adaptive method is used to determine the time of tracer absorption in kidney and background areas. The iterative convolution threshold method is used to minimize the energy function during kidney segmentation and significantly improve segmentation efficiency. This method analyzes the data of 174 patients using dynamic renal scintigraphy with <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">99m</sup>Tc-DTPA. Compared with the level set Chan-Vese method to minimize the energy function, the number of iterations of the iterative convolution threshold method is only one-third of the level set Chan-Vese method. The computer runtime is only one-fifth of the level set method. The clinical experimental results show that the iterative convolution threshold method has broad application prospects in accurately estimating the glomerular filtration rate in dynamic renal scintigraphy.

articleTitle: Bucket-FEM: A Bucket-based Architecture of Real-time ORB Feature Extraction and Matching for Embedded SLAM Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: ORB feature (Oriented-FAST and Rotated-BRIEF) is widely used in SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) systems. However, the processing power of embedded platforms is insufficient for the computation-intensive tasks of ORB FEM (feature extraction and matching). Based on our previous work, we propose Bucket-FEM: a bucket-based architecture for real-time ORB FEM accelerators. Firstly, the image is divided into non-overlapping blocks — buckets, and the FEM workflow is organized in the form of buckets. Bucket-based keypoint suppression is applied to reduce power consumption and computation complexity for FEM. Secondly, A novel bucket-based projection matching (BPM) scheme is proposed, which has time complexity of O(n) and delivers high matching performance with minimal resource usage. Finally, the motion-constant assumption is made to predict the model for BPM. The implementation on Vertex-7 XC7V2000T shows that Bucket-FEM supports ORB FEM for FHD images at 68.8fps when running at 142.8MHz, while consuming only 507mW dynamic power and the maximum absolute trajectory error increment is only 0.80mm, which is negligible for most SLAM scenarios.

articleTitle: A Complex Bayesian Wideband Compressed Spectrum Sensing Method Based on Incomplete Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Aiming at the blind detection problem of wide-band compressed spectrum sensing and the high computational complexity of Bayesian compressed sensing, this paper mainly proposes a wideband compressed spectrum sensing method based on complex Bayesian compressed sensing that does not require complete reconstruction. Compared with the wideband compressed spectrum sensing method, there is no need to know the signal’s sparsity. Compared with other Bayesian compressed sensing methods for wideband spectrum sensing, the difference is that it has applicability to complex signals and does not require complete reconstruction. Recover the original signal and then do wideband spectrum sensing. The advantage of this scheme is that it reduces the amount of calculation, facilitates engineering practice, and verifies the effectiveness of the method through simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Routing Algorithm for WSN Based on Hierarchical Clustering
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: This paper studies the routing algorithm of wireless sensor networks deployed along the railway. Aiming at the problem of node energy limitation in linear wireless sensor networks, a routing algorithm based on hierarchical clustering is proposed. The algorithm forms multiple simultaneous interpreting subpaths by dividing nodes into different sublayers, thus making full use of node energy. The performance of the algorithm is analyzed by simulation. And the simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively prolong the network lifetime and improve the utilization of the node energy.

articleTitle: The Frequency Constraints of Space-time Wideband Beamforming using Non-uniform Decomposition Method
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Space-time adaptive processing is an established method to design a wideband beamformer. In this paper, a novelty approach is proposed to directly obtain the minimum dimension of the frequency constraints for the adaptive spacetime wideband beamforming. The proposed algorithm uses nonuniform decomposition method to fast construct the frequency constraints without additional calculation, and the constraints can guarantee the space-time wideband beamformer with distortionless response to the signal of interests. Comparing with the singular value decomposition for the original frequency constraints to obtain the minimum dimension, the proposed algorithm can obtain the minimum dimension of the frequency constraints directly without any computational complexity, and they have the same performance on wideband beamforming. Simulation results highlight the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: On Efficient Segmentation of Parapharyngeal Fat Pads From Population-based MRIs: An Obstructive Sleep Apnea Application
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: The main purpose of our project was to automatically delineate parapharyngeal fat pads from magnetic resonance imaging (MR) data, since these structures are considered important for diagnosis of obstructive sleep apnea syndrome (OSAS). Here, we investigate the problem, discuss possible data choices, compare 2D and 3D networks, and consider several automated processing steps. First, approximately 75% of the sequence slices were excluded from further processing due to a subjects’ anatomy, and it allowed to reduce the training time. Second, 2D and 3D U-Net-based networks were trained on full slices to define the location of fat pads. Although the accuracy values on the validation set were lower in comparison to the human observer, both networks could detect the regions’ location. Finally, the slices were cropped using the ROI information from the previous step and separated in the middle. Another 3D network was trained and the results are comparable to intra-observer variability. Namely, the Dice coefficient on the test set was ≈ 78%, which was comparable to several readings of the same human observer. The presented approach will be applied to big epidemiological data to investigate the effects of the fat pad tissues on OSAS development.

articleTitle: The motor imagery EEG classification method combining common spatial pattern and ensemble learning
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: The performance of motor imagery EEG (MI-EEG) based brain-computer interface (BCI) is limited by the nonstationarity of EEG signal and small-sized training datasets. Although the ensemble learning (EL) using multiple base classifiers was suggested to be promising to solve this problem, the mislabeled trials in MI-EEG datasets will bring great challenges to design a set of qualified base classifiers in the ensemble framework. In this paper, the novel EL method with multiple base classifiers was studied in the context of MI-classification. In view of the importance of spatial filter in BCI construction, we focused on the spatial filter design based on a small number of training samples. We proposed a MI classification method that combines common spatial pattern (CSP) with ensemble learning (EL-CSP). We experimentally demonstrated that the base classifier based on a small number of training samples meets the requirements of EL. Thirty MI datasets of six subjects were employed to validate the proposed method in this study. The experimental results showed that the accuracy of EL-CSP obtained relative increment of 9.5% during self-testing, 1.2% during session-to-session transfer, and 1.7% during subject-to-subject transfer compared to the traditional classification methods based on CSP, respectively. Moreover, the proposed method has higher stability.

articleTitle: Gas-insulated Switchgear Discharge Pattern Recognition Based on KPCA and Multilayer Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Identifying the discharge type based on partial discharge signals in Gas-insulated Switchgear (GIS) equipment is very important for fault diagnosis and early warning of GIS equipment. This paper proposes a method to recognize different typical discharge types of GIS equipment through experiment. Firstly, different discharge defect models of GIS are built, and UHF sensors are used to detect and obtain partial discharge signals of discharge defects. Then, 3-dimentional PRPS patterns of different defects are drawn based on discharge signals. After that, 2-dimentional Gabor filter is applied to these patterns and texture and shape features are obtained. The dimension of the characteristics of discharge patterns is reduced by Kernel Principal Component Analysis (KPCA), and a multi-layer neural network is built to train and test the samples of discharge data. The results show that the recognition accuracy of three discharge types by using the multi-layer neural network can reach 83.3%, which is better than other algorithms, and can accurately diagnose the defect types of GIS.

articleTitle: A CoAP-based Decentralized Resource Discovery for IoT Network
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: This paper proposed the design and implementation of a framework that allows for the decentralized discovery of IoT resources. We discuss how to properly construct a 4-layer DHT-based P2P overlay network that supports the registration, discovery, and lookup of devices. A new multi-Chord ring structure with the Uniform Locality Preserving Hashing Function is used to realize the multi-attribute query and range query methods for resource discovery. We conducted comparative experiments in the Oversim to verify the improvement effect of our framework through comparison with the MAAN model.

articleTitle: An image destriping method combining feature extraction and nonlinear fitting
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: With the development of semiconductor technology, the performance of many new image sensors, such as infrared focal planes and CMOS image sensors, have been improved. Also, it is an alternative choice of CCD, vacuum tube or other equipment that promotes this kind of sensors to become the mainstream of the market. However, this kind of image sensors has a weakness that is the stripe noise, due to the inconsistent readout circuit response. This noise influences the quality of image directly, as a result, the poor image quality in-benefits for recognition and classification. Thus, how to remove the stripe noise arises the interests for many researchers. Most of them only focus on one certain type of stripe features, instead of combining different features together, leading to the poor performance of denoising. This paper proposes a method of removing stripes that combines feature extraction and function fitting. Firstly, extract the statistics and spatial position of the stripes, and then perform two steps of rough processing and fine processing on the image. The PSNR, SSM value show that the algorithm meets the design expectations and has a certain degree of robustness.

articleTitle: The Signal Feature Extraction of Graph Fourier Transform on the Constructed Graph
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Motivated by graph Fourier transform (GFT), we propose a novel signal processing method for feature extraction. Mapping the original signal into a transformed space by looking for a suitable basis, thereby observing the new feature of the signal in the transform domain, has always been the research content of signal processing. In a finite-dimensional transformation space, the original signal can be expressed as a vector. By constructing a set of orthogonal vectors containing the original signal, they become the eigenvectors of the Laplacian matrix of the constructed graph. In this way, the original signal is mapped to a point after the GFT, and the signal feature is obtained in the transformation domain. In the underwater target recognition experiment, the proposed method is suitable for underwater acoustic signal processing and has better performance than several common data construction graph model methods.

articleTitle: Experimental study on waveguide invariant passive ranging based on buoy
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: The important feature of ocean waveguides is that there is a stable and observable interference structure in the low-frequency sound field.This interference structure can be described by only one scalar parameter beta, which is called waveguide invariant. It reflects the relationship between distance, frequency and interference fringe slope. Therefore, the motion parameter information of the target can be obtained by analyzing the LOFAR diagram of the radiated noise of a moving ship, as a kind of equipment which is easy to be placed in the marine environment, buoy has been widely used in the field of underwater acoustics. In this paper, using the buoy test data, the distance information of the passive target is obtained by the waveguide invariant method, which overcomes the defect that the traditional buoy ranging method needs multiple buoys. The distance estimation of the passive target is realized only by a single buoy, and the distance measurement error within the effective range is no more than 10%.

articleTitle: Two Differential Schemes For Reflecting Modulation Aided Spatial Modulation System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) has been recently put forward as a promising technique for 6G and beyond 5G. In this paper, two differential schemes are proposed for reflecting modulation (RM) aided spatial modulation (SM) system: differential RM aided SM (DRM-SM) and differential SM aided RM (DSM-RM). Compared with the existing differential modulation scheme for RIS based systems, our proposed schemes not only dispense with channel state information (CSI) at the transceiver and RIS, but also improve the transmission rate. Finally, through the Monte Carlo simulations, it is shown that DRM-SM and DSM-RM schemes can achieve independent error performance advantages under different hardware facilities.

articleTitle: A Security Access Control Scheme of Smart Community under Epidemic Situation
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Identity authentication and access control are important technologies to realize the security control of the smart park. In this paper, attribute-based access control technology is used to judge whether users can pass the intelligent access control, and new conflict detection and resolution method is proposed for the possible conflict of joint authorization of different park managers. Through theoretical analysis and experimental verification, the attribute-based access control mechanism proposed in this paper can carry out more flexible and fine-grained permission control for users in smart parks.

articleTitle: The Research of Orthogonal Waveform Design for Ambiguity Feature Based on Distributed MIMO Radar
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Distributed fully coherent radar system can be regarded as a centralized MIMO radar, and its different signal forms lead to a variety of ambiguity characteristics. At the same time, the characteristic of system ambiguity function not only depends on the signal itself, but also has a close relationship with the array structure, especially the transmitting array structure. Therefore, taking uniform array as an example, this paper firstly introduce the working process requirements, and then gives the linear frequency modulated (LFM) and pulse-code modulated (PCM) designs. In the end, it is proposed two synthesized waveforms, which are stepped frequency divided linear frequency modulated (SFDLFM) and stepped frequency divided pulse-code modulated (SFDPCM) with genetic algorithm. The simulations are made to demonstrate the approaches are effective and validity and the related results can be extended to any array.

Author Keywords: stepped frequency divided linear frequency modulated

articleTitle: Attention Residual Connection Based Graph Convolution Networks for Skeleton-based Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: In the human skeleton-based action recognition area, most researches aim to extract and fuse the spatial and temporal information by exploiting Graph Convolution Networks (GCNs), which only consider the information propagation of nodes in small neighborhoods, ignoring the impact on the global graph. Therefore, the actions with complex spatial-temporal relationships are not effectively expressed. In this paper, we propose a novel Attention Residual Connection Based Graph Convolution Networks (ARGCNs) to further integrate spatial-temporal features of the global graph with graph attention mechanism and adaptive feature enhancement. Graph attention mechanism focus on identify the key points of every action, since a few joints are more critical than others of the whole body in some action. As the residual connection of ARGCNs, the graph attention mechanism can also increase the flexibility and generalization of model. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed model is effective, and is competitive compared with state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Resolution Improvement for Automotive Radar with Chirp Sequence Waveform
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: The two-dimensional fast Fourier transform (2D FFT) method is commonly used to measure range and velocity of targets for automotive frequency modulated continuous wave (FMCW) radar with chirp sequence waveform. Whereas, the resolution in range and velocity are restricted by the bandwidth and integration time, respectively. In view of the sparsity of targets in the space (SS), this paper proposes two novel models based on compressed sensing (CS) technology to address the above issue. Specifically, the first model termed CS-SS provides higher range resolution by set more mesh points along the range dimension than the samples in one chirp period. To reduce the data size for the reconstruction procedure of the first model for improving the velocity resolution simultaneously, the second model termed FFT-CS-SS, which takes a series of steps to down-sample the data after 2D FFT, is established. Simulations demonstrate the effectiveness, robustness, and the higher ranging accuracy of the proposed models.

articleTitle: Depth-guided Deformable Convolutions for RGB-D Saliency Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Recently, RGB-D salient object detection(SOD) has attracted increasing research interests, and existing methods have achieved huge success owing to well-designed feature extraction and fusion. However, in existing methods, the depth maps cannot be utilized entirely since RGB and depth are usually concatenated together as an entirety and then feed into the backbone to extract features, which cannot achieve the spatial supervision between both modals. In this letter, we propose a Depth-guided Deformable 3D Convolution (Guided-Conv) to solve this problem. Specifically, the Guided-Conv obtains the sampling offset of the 3D convolution kernel guided by the extra depth input, enabling the convolutional layer to change the receptive field and adapt to geometric cross-modal transformations. Besides, the Guided-Conv also incorporates geometric cues into the forward propagation by producing spatially adaptive filter weights. Based on comprehensive experiments on several extensively used bench-marks, the Guided-Conv yields strong results against several state-of-the-art RGB-D SOD approaches based on four key evaluation metrics.

articleTitle: Interference State Estimation-Based LDPC Decoding Scheme Design for Slow FH System
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of unsatisfactory performance of the low-density parity-check (LDPC) belief propagation decoding algorithm in the LDPC coded frequency hopping (FH) system when the interference state is unknown, an LDPC layered decoding scheme based on interference state estimation is proposed. The iterative feedback estimation mechanism is used to estimate the interference state of the hop according to the posterior message of the variable node in each hop obtained in each iteration, and then update the decoding prior probability message of the next iteration to realize the LDPC decoding under the interference state estimation Process. The simulation results show that the scheme has better decoding performance and decoding convergence. When the number of hop bits is greater than or equal to 10, the decoding performance is equivalent to the known interference state, and the complexity of the scheme is not enormous.

articleTitle: An Inter-Satellite Communication Scheme Based on Real-time Doppler Frequency Offset Compensation
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Such transmission performance as acquisition performance and bit error rate (BER) may be reduced with the large Doppler frequency offset (DFO) without compensation in inter-satellite communication, thus a competitive inter-satellite communication scheme based on real-time DFO compensation is proposed. Both satellites in an inter-satellite link firstly predict the visible period and DFO simultaneously according to their respective orbit parameters, and in succession established a DFO compensation table respectively before the transmission started. Then carrier frequency offset compensation is performed when each packet transmission was commenced by looking up the DFO compensation table. The comparison of correlation peak loss exploited to denote the acquisition performance for such communication scheme adopting direct sequence spread spectrum modulation with and without DFO compensation was simulated. The feasibility was verified by simulation.

articleTitle: An Artificial Intelligence Instructional System to Promote Learning on Rice Farming Basing on the Philosophy of Sufficiency Economy for Farmers in the Upper Northeastern Thailand
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Thailand has played a major role in exporting rice in the international market. However, the system for supporting career development and lifelong learning of rice farmers living in rural areas had not been well developed. Therefore, we developed an e-learning system with social-media-based communications for those in the Upper Northeastern Thailand (the poorest region). Results show that a majority of farmers who used the developed e-learning system answered that they were satisfied with their learning experience. Our study highlights the importance of the local contexts and local needs, which can be incorporated upon the developing an education tool.

Author Keywords: and Philosophy of the sufficiency economy

articleTitle: DOA Estimation Based on CNN in L-type Mutual Matrix
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Direction of arrival (DOA) estimation of space signal is a basic problem in array signal processing, and it is also one of the important tasks in radar, sonar and many other fields. Traditional algorithms such as MUSIC have poor real-time performance and low accuracy, and the complexity of 2D-MUSIC is greatly increased. Therefore, convolutional neural network(CNN) is introduced to DOA estimation in recent ten years, and the weights of CNN are shared, which greatly reduces the training complexity. Therefore, CNN is used as the basic framework of DOA estimation. In order to improve the performance of CNN DOA estimation, the following two improved methods are proposed. (1) Sparse array can reduce the cost and system complexity. To solve the problem of angle ambiguity in sparse array, coprime array would be combined with CNN. (2) In order to solve the problem that CNN feature information is not fully used, Attention mechanism is introduced in CNN for DOA estimation, which establishes Attention-CNN algorithm, and different weights are assigned to each channel. Simulation results show that the DOA estimation based on Attention-CNN can improve the estimation accuracy and reduce the computational complexity, which performs better than MUSIC and other traditional algorithms.

articleTitle: Low Complexity Data Mapping and Detection for Jointly Mapping Generalized Spatial Modulation
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: In this paper, data mapping and detection are addressed for the jointly mapping generalized spatial modulation (JM-GSM) system. In order to meet the transmission rate of the system, an efficient data mapping scheme is proposed by maximizing the minimum Euclidean distance (MED) with the aid of the channel state information (CSI). To reduce the computational complexity of the maximum likelihood (ML) detector, a probability-ordering-based sphere decoding (PO-SD) detector for the JM-GSM system is proposed. The detector sorts the transmit vectors in the jointly mapping table according to the probability of the antenna being activated, and then detects the sorted transmit vectors using the sphere decoding (SD) algorithm. Simulation results show that the combination of the proposed data mapping scheme and the PO-SD detector can provide satisfactory bit error performance while maintaining low computational complexity.

Author Keywords: bit error rate (BER) probability-ordering-based sphere (PO-SD) detector

articleTitle: Evaluating the Performance of Synthetic Visual Data for Real-Time Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: A method to produce synthetic visual data was developed for this study. The resulting synthetic imagery was used to train a YOLOv3 classification model to identify various species of sea turtles. The Blender library and Python were used to render and augment the images. Nine datasets were generated, each with different ratios of synthetic and authentic images. YOLOv3 was then trained and the performance resulting from each of the datasets was evaluated to measure which dataset produced the most confident model. The researchers optimized the classification model and demonstrated significant accuracy improvements, especially with models trained without authentic data. A dataset consisting of fully synthetic dataset performed best in testing, with an average confidence level of 9.68 percent greater than the fully authentic dataset.

articleTitle: Adaptive Space-time Broadband Beamforming using Machine Learning approach
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Adaptive space-time broadband beamforming technology is a significant branch of array signal processing. For the conventional iterative algorithms of the broadband beamforming, the iteration step is always the fixed constant for each approach. In this paper, a variable step gradient algorithm based on machine learning is proposed for the adaptive space-time broadband beamforming, namely adaptive gradient Frost beamformer (AGFB) and adaptive gradient frequency constrained Frost beamformer (AGFCFB). Using the concept of adaptive gradient (AdaGrad) in machine learning (ML), the iterative formulas of adaptive broadband beamformers are ameliorated. The algorithm has the capability of adjusting the step of each approximation for different parameter values independently, making the entire process of iteration more flexible. Meanwhile, the convergence rates of the proposed beamformers are faster than the conventional algorithms. Simulation results highlight the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Analysis and experiment of effective factors in industrial CT dimensional measurement
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: In the manufacturing process for complex parts, industrial CT is not only used for defect detection, but also more and more used for dimensional measurement. Aiming at the effective factors of industrial CT in dimensional measurement, this paper compares and analyzes the scan magnification ratio, feature size, cone angle, part material and segmentation algorithm through numerical simulation. It is found that the segmentation algorithm has the greatest impact on the measurement accuracy within the set conditions. And there are obvious and systematic property, including over-segmentation and under-segmentation on the entity features and cavity features. According to the CT dimensional measurement, the results of the standard parts are verified. Moreover, the research has great significance for the dimensional measurement and calibration of industrial CT, subsequently.

articleTitle: High Resolution ISAR Imaging for Maritime Targets by Encoder-Decoder Network Combined with the Time-Frequency Attention
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: The Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar (ISAR) imaging result of a rotating maritime target is usually defoculsing since the complex sea conditions may cause time-varying spin speed of targets. A common solution is to utilize range instantaneous Doppler (RID) algorithm for short time imaging, however, the RID algorithm suffers from the low time-frequency resolution. Therefore, this paper proposes an Encoder-Decoder neural net-work combined with Time-Frequency Attention (TFA) module to enhance instantaneous frequency resolution. The TFA module is utilized to extract the spectral lines of weak scatterers, further, the Encoder-Decoder network is designed to transform the low-resolution time-frequency refined by the TFA module to their high-resolution counterparts. Finally, the performance of the proposed method is evaluated on the simulated and real measured data. Both imaging and numerical results certify the meliority of the proposed method in enhancing frequency resolution and reserving the spectral lines of weak scatterers.

articleTitle: Research on Diagnosis and Positioning Method of Typical Partial Discharge Defects in Gas-insulated Switchgear
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Gas-insulated switchgear (GIS) is one of the important equipment in power system. Using UHF partial discharge detection method to find and diagnose internal insulation defects in time is an important means during the operation and maintenance of GIS equipment. Different discharge types in GIS show different partial discharge characteristics. This paper proposes a diagnosis and positioning method of discharge faults in GIS equipment through experiments. Firstly, UHF partial discharge signals of different typical discharge models in GIS are obtained by UHF sensor, and then 3D GIS PRPS patterns are drawn. After that, PRPS patterns are transformed into 3 decomposition patterns through Gabor transform, and the texture and shape features of these decomposition patterns are extracted. Based on extracted characteristics, different kinds of machine learning algorithms are applied to identify the discharge type. The results show that the recognition accuracy of three typical discharge types by different machine learning algorithms is high. The characteristics extracted from decomposition patterns obtained by Gabor transform well reflect the discharge type and has high discrimination. Combined with relevant positioning algorithms of GIS, the fault location can be better realized when the rough location of defects is known when accurate identification of partial discharge defects is obtained. This diagnosis method can provide a reliable reference basis for the early warning and accurate location of GIS faults.

articleTitle: Optimal Cyclic (r, δ) Locally Repairable Codes With r + δ - 1 = (q+1)/4
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Locally repairable codes (LRCs), due to the local erasure-correcting property, have been widely used in distributed storage systems. In this paper, we construct cyclic (r, δ) LRCs ((r, δ) CLRCs) which are optimal according to the Singleton-like bound. The locality of the new CLRCs satisfies that $r + \delta - 1 = \frac{{q + 1}}{4}$. This is different from those of CLRCs obtained by Qian and Zhang in 2020 which are $r + \delta - 1 = q + 1{\text{ and }}r + \delta - 1 = \frac{{q + 1}}{2}$. Then the parameters of our CLRCs are new.

articleTitle: Efficient Two-Dimensional DOA Estimation for Coprime-Displaced Three Parallel Nested Arrays
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an efficient approach to estimate the directions-of-arrival (DOAs) of two dimensional (2-D) signals for coprime-displaced three parallel nested arrays (CPNAs), where the difference virtual coarray is exploited to realize the array aperture extension and degrees-of-freedom enhancement as a result. Specifically, the proposed approach is designed to fully make use of the auto-covariance matrix and cross-covariance matrix among the three subarrays, with which an augmented covariance matrix is formed. Then a reduced dimensional approach is proposed to decompose the 2-D problem as two one-dimensional (1-D) estimation problems via polynomial rooting with automatic angle pairing. The coprime displacement between the adjacent subarrays is adopted to enhance the resolution ability. Simulations are used to verify the improvement in estimation performance of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Research on multifunctional fault simulation system of electric power optical transport network
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: With the rapid construction of electric power optical transport network, it is urgent to build the effective and flexible network fault simulation environment to improve the fault analysis and handling competence of communication operation and maintenance personnel. Aiming at the problems of fault training and drill environment built with real OTN equipments, this paper proposes an all-digital multifunctional optical transport network fault simulation solution. This paper introduces the architecture of the simulation system. Then key technologies of the system are explained, such as OTN equipment mechanism model, optical signal panoramic simulation and alarm automatic generation. Finally, the application of the system is briefly introduced.

articleTitle: The vegetation coverage change analysis based on the time series of images for construction area of pumped storage power station
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: The vegetation change monitoring of engineering construction project usually adopts manual investigation, which is difficult to timely monitor the change. The pumped storage power station project is often constructed in mountain area, which will damage natural resources and arises soil erosion. In order to timely analyse vegetation change caused by pumped storage power station project, the study uses five series of remote sensing image data with sub-meter resolution to obtain the vegetation coverage among different construction stages. The pixel binary model was used to estimate the vegetation coverage. The results shows the vegetation coverage for whole study area is decreasing trend since the Jixi pumped storage power station has begun to construct. In 2015~2017, there is obviously reduction in the stage of large excavation. In 2017~2020, a increasing trend of vegetation coverage appears because of manually vegetation restoration measures with project completion. Therefore, the vegetation coverage rate of remote sensing images can be used to monitor the vegetation change due to project construction. And it is better to select the time series of images in the same season for ensuring the accuracy of the analysis. The study provides a method of vegetation change monitoring based on remote sensing during engineering construction period, which can improve the ability of project supervision.

articleTitle: Remote Evaluation System for Historical frescos on Curved Surface with Laser Vibrometer Scan
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to propose a contactless evaluation system with fiber laser Doppler vibrometer to diagnose the location of frescos damage for historical frescos on curved surface. This article outlines a non-invasive diagnostic test system and procedure, advantage of which is no damage to the artwork, and that is based on the frequency response analysis of the acoustic excitation of the wall vibration. The detail of the test procedure for wall vibration and the system of the measurement instrument is described. Experiments were performed on a real artificial fresco in a historic curved vault. A 2D map of curved surface oscillate amplitudes is generated by measuring points by points on the surface. This false-color image is further treated through image analysis procedure to settle the locality and structure of the destruction area.

articleTitle: Ordinary Differential Equation Identification Based on Sparse Bayesian Learning and Collaborative Neurodynamic Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Sparse Bayesian learning based on collaborative neurodynamic optimization (CNO-SBL) is a novel neural network approach proposed recently for sparse regression. In this paper, we demonstrate how well CNO-SBL performs for ordinary differential equation identification. It is shown that the approach is capable of recovering ordinary differential equations and outperforms the sequentially thresholded least square (STLS) algorithm in terms of accuracy for small size of dictionaries.

articleTitle: A secure face authentication scheme based on honeypot technology
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Biometric verification is considered to be one of the most reliable approaches to identity authentication. But biometric characteristics cannot be changed. The loss of privacy is permanent if they are ever compromised. In this paper, we develop a secure face authentication scheme based on honeypot technology. First, random projection technology is used to encrypt the original face feature data, which can not only provide privacy protection but also preserve the Euclidean distance and the accuracy of the certification results. Secondly, we use the fuzzy commitment scheme in the biometric encryption system to complete the face identity authentication, and further improve the security of the biometric template stored in the database. However, cryptographic hashes have only computational security whose being cracked shall leak the biometric feature, and existing face template protection schemes rarely detect whether the template has been leaked from the database or not during the verification process. Therefore, we proposed to detect the hashed password cracking, to enable the detectability of biometric template database leakage. Finally, we analyzed the performance of the proposed scheme and verified the effectiveness of the scheme.

articleTitle: Authentication and Key Agreement Protocol for Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: The rise of edge computing has promoted the large-scale deployment of terminal embedded devices. Although the convenience of data collection is increased, the security of private data is facing serious threats. This paper designs an identity authentication and key agreement based on elliptic curve public key cryptography Protocol. It consists of four phases: system setup phase, embedded registration phase, edge registration phase, and identity authentication phase. This article uses BAN-logic to give a formal security analysis of the protocol. Security analysis and performance evaluation show that in the terminal embedded system, the security of the key is significantly enhanced, and a variety of attacks against the embedded system can be effectively resisted by the key. The additional overhead added by this protocol will not have a significant impact on system performance.

articleTitle: Path Planning for Underwater Glider Based on Ant Colony Algorithm Guided by Artificial Potential Field
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: This paper studies the path planning of underwater gliders in a global static environment, and proposes an improved algorithm based on ant colony algorithm, which eliminates the problem of slow convergence due to the lack of initial pheromone in path planning of ant colony algorithm. Firstly, according to the operating characteristics of the glider, the grid method is used to model the known marine environment; Secondly, the improved artificial potential field method is introduced to construct the heuristic information function to speed up the convergence speed of the ant colony algorithm; Finally, the ant colony algorithm is used to search Path, improve the original pheromone update rule of the ant colony algorithm. The simulation results show that the algorithm in this paper is effective and superior.

articleTitle: Log-Euclidean Kernel Sparse Representation on DR-Spectral SPD Matrices for Signal Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel signal detection method in the framework of matrix information geometry and apply it to target detection in complex clutter. The sample data is first assumed to be constructed as a high-dimensional spectral SPD matrix by extracting the SIFT feature from the spectrogram obtained by STFT procedure. In this case, a high-dimensional SPD manifold is naturally modeled, which yields rich information from signal data. To eliminate the redundancy while preserve the original structure of the data, we first employ the dimensionality reduction (DR) method on the high-dimensional SPD manifold, then through Log-Euclidean Kernel sparse representation for the DR-spectral SPD matrices lying on a lower-dimensional SPD manifold, we finally perform a binary classification (the absence or presence of the objective signal) on a discriminative Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space with low computational complexity. Similar researches, for instance, directly identify the spectral line or peak in the spectrogram, however, provide a poor description for signal data, which results in unsatisfactory detection performance. Experimental results based on real sea clutter show great information for complex signal detection tasks from signal data analysis with matrix information geometry, which can be widely used in signal processing.

articleTitle: Improved algorithm of channelized Spectrum Sensing based on Eigenvalue
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: In the process of channelization, the traditional spectrum detection algorithm has low perception accuracy and cannot correctly determine the presence or absence of sub-band signals after polyphase decomposition. An improved channelized spectrum detection algorithm based on eigenvalue detection is proposed. The algorithm is based on a spectrum sensing fusion algorithm, combined with the characteristics of the channelized sub-band signal, selects the maximum eigenvalue, average eigenvalue and geometric mean eigenvalue of the covariance matrix as test statistics, and derives the expression of the detection threshold. Through simulation experiments, the proposed algorithm has a higher detection probability than existing algorithms in the channelization sub-band signal spectrum detection, which provides a theoretical solution for the blind channelization process.

articleTitle: Traffic Classification and Attack Detection Based on Flow Inspection over Data Link Layer
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: This paper presents a DDoS attack detection method in VSAT satellite system. Different from the traditional way of analyzing traffic and attack behavior on the view of application layer or network layer, this paper explores the relevant characteristics of traffic behavior from the perspective of data link layer, screens them according to the information gain of characteristics, and selects the appropriate characteristics as the input of random forest model to recognize attacks. On the premise of identifying the basic data application types, Dynamic Time Warping index is used to measure the similarity between different application traffic. Normal traffic streams and DDoS attack streams are distinguished according to obvious differences of jitter and delay. Experiments show that the adaption capability of proposed method on traffic classification and attack detection are satisfied.

articleTitle: Electricity Federated Strategies Based on Restricted Solution Space
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Technology of big data can provide effective technical support for decision-making in production, sales, service of electricity-related industries. However, electricity data can reflect user privacy information and enterprises business secrets. The increasingly privacy protection restrictions make it impossible to directly use electricity data for interaction and sharing. Federated- learning technology helps power grid enterprises to do collaborative analysis and joint model establishment under the condition of ensuring data privacy. The power system has a large geographical span and wide coverage, and there are huge differences in geography, climate, and development in different regions. Differences in data distribution have a greater impact on the effect of federated analysis and modeling. Accoding to the high-dimension and non-convex characteristic of neural network, we propose comprehensive strategies including learning rate fast attenuation, strong regularization, and an additional term to limit the solution space, so as to reduce the negative impact of dataset differences of electricity data on the final model.

articleTitle: Research on the influence of object surface discontinuity on target acoustic scattering characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: This article focuses on the influence of the discontinuous surface of a combination of simple structures on the scattering characteristics of the target. The three-dimensional vector model is used to simulate the constructed model group. Through numerical simulation, the scattering characteristics of the target discontinuous surface are analyzed on the relationship between the gap width and the wavelength, and the target characteristic changes caused by the target discontinuous surface are obtained. Under the same working conditions, for different incident angles, the trend of the echo energy at the gap changing with frequency is almost the same. For different types of gap shapes, the target echo energy is weak when the gap boundary is smooth.

articleTitle: A positioning method of ablation needles in X-ray CT images
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: CT Image-guided interventional therapy has been widely used in clinical application, especially for cancer treatments. However, metal artifacts often appear in CT imaging of the metal ablation needles. These artifacts seriously affect the doctor's diagnosis of the ablation needle positioning. We propose an accurate positioning method which can correct the artifacts and detect the geometric information of ablation needles. Firstly, the layered technology of the multi-energy projection data is given to eliminate metal artifacts; then the corrected CT images are preprocessed for positioning; finally, the "pinpoint" positioning of the needles is realized by DBSCAN (Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise) clustering. The experimental results show that the proposed method can provide fast and accurate positioning for the ablation needle.

articleTitle: Home Video Behavior Recognition based on Convolutional Residual Network with Visual Privacy Protection Mechanism and Temporal Adaptive Module
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: To address the privacy leakage issue that exists in home surveillance video, and considering that 3D Convolutional Neural Network (3D CNN) simply uses a fixed number of video invariant cores, it does not realize the time difference between videos, this paper proposes a home behavior video recognition algorithm based on computer vision considering privacy protection. The system combines compressed sensing (CS) theory with convolutional residual network of temporal adaptive module (TAM). Firstly, compressed sensing technology is used to make video obtain the required "visual masking domain", and then TAM is inserted into 2D Deep Residual Network (2D ResNet). TAM is composed of two modules cascaded together before and after, which give the temporal information in the video sequence into a mapping based on important sensitive locations and a mapping based on invariant locations, using this system to enable the effective identification of behaviors in compressed video.

Author Keywords: Convolutional residual network of temporal adaptive module

articleTitle: A Novel Insect Sound Recognition Algorithm Based on MFCC and CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: It is very necessary to recognize the sound of insects by using the differences sound between the different kinds of insects when they are moveing, feeding, and calling. Therefore, the insect sound recognition algorithm based on Mel Cepstrum Coefficient (MFCC) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is proposed in this paper. After the sound samples are preprocessed, Mel Cepstral Coefficients (MFCCs) are extracted from the sound samples as feature parameters, and then the sound is converted into a feature map. Finally, the feature map is input into the constructed convolutional neural network (CNN) for training. Through the setting of hyperparameters and the selection of optimization algorithms, the trained network is used to recognition insect sound. Its average recognition rate reached 92.56%, which greatly improved the accuracy of insect voice recognition. The test results prove that MFCC and CNN can be used to effectively identify insects.

articleTitle: Intelligent Logistics Technology and Big Data in the Construction and Development of Smart City
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Due to the incompleteness of planning ideas and construction methods, there are many problems in urban construction: the planning lacks prospectiveness, does not match the development needs of the city, and repeated construction is common; the community has insufficient functions and transportation. Therefore, it is of great significance to explore the path of smart city construction and development. This article mainly studies the application of intelligent logistics technology and big data in the construction and development of smart cities. Starting from the two main theories of theory and reality, this article first discusses the challenges of the big data era background to urban construction, analyzes the relationship between big data and smart cities, and then takes urban logistics big data as an object to study smart city construction. The smart logistics technology pointed out the convenience brought by the smart logistics technology and big data technology in the construction of smart cities. Finally, by drawing on the advanced experience of using big data in some cities at home and abroad to promote the construction of smart cities, the use of big data and smart logistics Technology assists the construction of smart cities, and has made concrete and detailed suggestions. The experimental results of this paper show that the group size is 60, the number of iterations is 30, and the minimum logistics cost through iteration is 1,284,100 yuan. In this paper, the logistics management method of intelligent logistics technology based on big data can minimize the logistics cost. This article provides some theoretical guidance for the key technical aspects of logistics network warehousing, service and resource management in the construction and development of smart cities, and provides guarantee for urban construction and stable development, which has certain reference significance for better and longer-term development.

articleTitle: Radar Emitter Recognition Method Based on Bispectrum and Improved Multi-channel Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that a kind of bispectrum one-dimensional data is extracted as the individual identification feature of radar emitter resulting in the loss of a lot of useful information in a complex electromagnetic environment, we make full use of the characteristic of symmetry of bispectrum structures, fuse the extracted bispectrum structure, and input an improved multi-channel one-dimensional convolutional neural network in parallel in this paper. Softmax classifier is used for radar emitter identification, so as to improve the recognition rate of individual radar emitter. The simulation experiment uses four kinds of homotype radar to test. Experimental results show that compared with the radar emitter identification method based on 1D-CNN for a single bisspectral one-dimensional feature, the proposed method has the ability of deep feature mining, reduces the loss of useful information, and improves the individual recognition rate of radar emitter effectively.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Landmark-based Attention Network for Students’ Facial Expression Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Facial expression recognition (FER) has made a great progress in recent years, however there are still challenges in for real situations, which always has low-quality datasets with low resolution or occlusion, such as students’ emotions. In facial expression images, front face and some salient regions contain effective expressional features. Hence, successfully extracting these features helps achieve FER task. Facing these challenges, we create a network combining convolutional neural network and landmark-based attention mechanism. Attention maps of face mask and salient regions are generated with the help of landmarks, which are refined adaptively by landmark-based feature module. These landmark-based features are extracted to alleviate the impact of low-quality images. Finally, landmark-based features are integrated with global features for FER. By comparison with latest state-of-the-art methods, the results on student-emotion-dataset and other different datasets prove that our method performs well.

articleTitle: Characterizing Laser-induced Acoustic Signals Based on Thermal Expansion Mechanism: Simulation Studies and Experiment Verifications
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: The paper elaborates the principle of the interaction between laser and water, and further explores the design of air-to-underwater (A2U) communication systems, all corroborated by extensive experiment results. Based on the theory of laser-excited planar sound source under the thermal expansion mechanism, a laser sound generation system was designed, from which the laser sound signals were acquired and measured. In particular, the sound signals generated under different laser conditions were compared and analyzed. Each optoacoustic signal induced in the experiment has a wide frequency band, relatively dispersed energy, and the spectral energy center is in tens of kHz, which makes it not suitable for long-distance underwater transmission. To tackle this challenge, this paper makes the attempt to utilize the re-frequency method to modulate the laser-induced acoustic signal, showing a glimmer of hope of adopting laser-induced acoustic signals in underwater applications.

articleTitle: Epilepsy detection from EEG data using 2D Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: An epileptic seizure, a disorder in brain functionality, happens when electrical bursts spread across the brain, causing the person to lose control or consciousness. Predicting epileptic seizures before they occur is useful for seizure prevention with medicine or for neural pre-surgical planning. Machine learning and computational methods are used to predict epileptic seizures from electroencephalogram (EEG) recordings. However, noise removal and feature extraction in EEG data are two important challenges that have a negative impact on the effectiveness of both time and true positive prediction rate. We offer a model in this paper that provides a reliable strategy for both preprocessing and feature extraction. Our model is based on a two-dimensional Convolution Neural Network (CNN), with EEG input provided to the CNN in the form of two-dimensional images. On the University of Bonn data set’s normal vs intericatl vs ictal instance, our proposed system achieved 97.8 percent accuracy and over 97 percent for the other parameters, which include precision, recall, F1-score, and ROC-AUC. Our findings are reproducible using the code available on github [1].

articleTitle: Fine-grained Visual Classification by Progressive Training via Jigsaw Puzzle Permutation Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 6th International Conference on Communication, Image and Signal Processing (CCISP)
abstract: Fine-grained visual classification remains a challenging task due to small inter-class differences and large intraclass differences. Existing methods consider only local details of information or only global information at a certain stage. However, there methods do not consider the complementary relationship between local information of different granularity and global information of the overall object on the feature maps of different stages of the network. To solve the above problem, we propose a Progressively Trained Jigsaw Puzzle Permutation Learning network (PPL-Net).
